description: Ornith-1.5-122B (Qwen3.5-MoE architecture) as MiaAI-Lab's 4-bpw EXL3 EAQv1 checkpoint (revision 9c5c913b, 62 GiB on disk) with incoai's DFlash2 draft model, on one DGX Spark through TensorFold's Zig engine (tensorfold-native, commit d1018b31) plus MiaAI-Lab's patches 0001 to 0027 (EXL3 for the Qwen3.5-MoE CUDA engine, DFlash2, prompt and decode kernels). Runs MiaAI-Lab's published image of her kit (0c8fd6a0), zig-d1018b3-f5683f4c5651 (sha256:56c064d22327a6d0ce09d0de3930084b11841918072e9467a2dd9039b3d92b82), as published and not rebuilt, with only a thin layer for the Controller's launcher. Four streams, a 262,144-token window, fp8 KV cache (lossy; bf16 is exact), image input (the engine rejects video) and replies of up to 32,768 tokens without max_tokens. DFlash2 output matched the no-draft run on 21 of 21 greedy prompts (creator-measured). The declared peak follows the creator's measurements: about 69.5 GiB for the weights, drafter and scratch on the device, four full fp8 windows with their GatedDeltaNet state, the 2 GiB vision workspace and a prompt cache of up to 16 GiB; the engine keeps 10 GiB free when it sizes the pool. Upstream performance (prefill about 2,450 tok/s at 4k, decode 53 tok/s prose and 83 tok/s code on one stream) is the creator's measurement on one DGX Spark, not measured here. The checkpoint is MIT-licensed on its model card; the DFlash2 draft model is Apache-2.0. Thinking is chosen per request (chat template kwargs), not as a recipe option; server default: think first (upstream default).
title: Ornith 1.5 122B EXL3 DFlash2 TensorFold single Spark (Mia)
